It is\ndeliberately self-contained: a single SQLite database, a handful of domain\nclasses, and Symfony `HttpFoundation` + `Routing` for HTTP handling.\n\n## Quick start\n\nInstall dependencies (already vendored in this workspace):\n\n```bash\ncomposer install\n```\n\nStart the server in the foreground on the port defined by the `PORT`\nenvironment variable:\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` first calls `reset.php` to clear legacy JSON files and truncate the\nSQLite data tables, then launches PHP's built-in server bound to\n`127.0.0.1:$PORT` using `index.php` as the router script.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset persisted state:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Project layout\n\n```\n.\n├── index.php              # Entry point: bootstrap storage, build routes, dispatch requests\n├── reset.php              # Pre-startup database reset (used by run.sh)\n├── run.sh                 # Foreground server startup\n├── composer.json          # Pins Symfony HttpFoundation 8.1.1 and Symfony Routing 8.1.0\n├── src/\n│   ├── Storage/\n│   │   └── GameStorage.php       # All SQLite schema, queries and reset logic\n│   ├── Domain/\n│   │   ├── Dice.php              # Dice expression parsing and statistics\n│   │   ├── Initiative.php        # Deterministic initiative sorting\n│   │   ├── Encounter.php         # Encounter difficulty / adjusted XP\n│   │   ├── CharacterRules.php    # Ability modifiers, proficiency, derived stats\n│   │   ├── RestRules.php         # Spell slots, long rest, equipment load\n│   │   ├── SpellRules.php        # Class-based spell validation\n│   │   └── CampaignAnalytics.php # Campaign readiness/risk scoring\n│   ├── Http/\n│   │   ├── HttpException.php     # Domain exception carrying HTTP status code\n│   │   ├── HttpHelper.php        # JSON body parsing and error responses\n│   │   ├── AuthHelper.php        # Bearer-token authentication and role checks\n│   │   └── Controllers.php       # One method per HTTP route\n│   ├── Routing/\n│   │   └── Router.php            # RouteCollection definition\n│   └── Util/\n│       └── Numbers.php           # Whole-number float normalisation\n└── game.db                # Runtime SQLite database (created on first boot)\n```\n\n## Entry point and routing\n\n`index.php` performs the following steps on every request:\n\n1. Loads `vendor/autoload.php`.\n2. Creates `App\\Storage\\GameStorage`, which ensures the SQLite schema exists.\n3. Creates `App\\Http\\Controllers`; `App\\Routing\\Router` builds the\n   `RouteCollection` from that instance.\n4. Builds a `Request` from globals once, then derives a `RequestContext` from\n   it and creates a `UrlMatcher`.\n5. Matches the incoming `Request` against the route collection.\n6. Calls the matched controller callable with `($request, $parameters)`.\n7. Catches `App\\Http\\HttpException` → JSON error response with the carried\n   status code (400/401/403/409), then `ResourceNotFoundException` → 404 and\n   `MethodNotAllowedException` → 405.\n8. Sends the resulting `JsonResponse`.\n\nAll route definitions are in `src/Routing/Router.php`. Controller methods are\nordinary public methods on `Controllers`; they are registered as\n`[$controllers, 'methodName']` callables. This keeps the dispatch code in\n`index.php` tiny and makes the routing table easy to scan. `Router` uses small\nprivate `get`/`post`/`put` helpers to reduce the visual noise of the Symfony\n`Route` constructor arguments.\n\nAuthentication/authorization is handled through `AuthHelper` so controllers do\nnot repeat the same bearer-token and role checks. `HttpException` lets a\ncontroller fail fast with the same status codes and messages the original\nimplementation returned manually; `index.php` translates the exception into a\nuniform JSON response.\n\n## State and persistence\n\nAll persistent state lives in a single SQLite database (`game.db`). The schema is\ncreated idempotently by `GameStorage::initialize()` on every request if the\ntables do not exist. Foreign keys are enabled.\n\nTables:\n\n- `schema_version` — single-row schema marker (currently version 1).\n- `users` — username, password hash (bcrypt), role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `combat_sessions` / `combat_conditions` — round, turn index, initiative order\n  and conditions tied to a combat target.\n- `compendium_monsters` / `compendium_items` — monster and item entries keyed\n  by slug.\n- `campaigns` / `campaign_characters` / `campaign_events` — campaign data,\n  characters, and log entries.\n- `quests` / `quest_milestones` — quest tracking with milestone completion.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — faction and NPC relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and character item ownership.\n- `downtime_crafting` — crafting project progress.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `session_attendance` — session scheduling and RSVP.\n- `play_campaigns` / `play_campaign_members` / `play_campaign_narrations` /\n  `play_campaign_documents` — collaborative play-campaign turn queue,\n  narration log, and shared document.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` / `play_campaign_locations` /\n  `play_campaign_location_connections` / `play_campaign_encounters` —\n  scene graph, travel edges, and active encounters.\n- `play_campaign_character_spells` — known spells per character.\n\n`GameStorage::reset()` truncates all data tables, re-seeds the schema version,\nand deletes legacy `.combat-state.json` / `.users.json` files. `reset.php`\nperforms this before the server starts, and `run.sh` no longer duplicates the\ntruncate list. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint also calls\n`GameStorage::reset()` at runtime.\n\n`GameStorage::initialize()` also performs lightweight column migrations via\n`addColumnIfMissing()` so older copies of `game.db` gain new columns (e.g.\n`play_campaigns.current_actor`, `campaign_inventory.source`) automatically.\n\n## Domain groupings\n\nThe API surface is grouped by URL prefix:\n\n| Prefix The method signature is\n  `methodName(Request $request, array $parameters): JsonResponse`.\n- **Keep domain logic pure.** If a calculation is used by more than one endpoint,\n  place it in `src/Domain/`. ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$id]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        $row['round'] = (int) $row['round'];\n        $row['turn_index'] = (int) $row['turn_index'];\n        $row['order'] = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        unset($row['order_json']);\n\n        return $row;\n    }\n\n    public function getConditionsForTarget(string $sessionId, string $target): array\n    {\n        $stmt = AND target = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$sessionId, $target]);\n        $result = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $result[] = [\n                'condition' => $row['condition'],\n                'remaining_rounds' => (int) $row['remaining_rounds'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        return $result;\n    }\n\n    public function getConditionsMap(string $sessionId): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$sessionId]);\n        $map = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $map[$row['target']][] = [\n                'condition' => $row['condition'],\n                'remaining_rounds' => (int) $row['remaining_rounds'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        return $map;\n    }\n\n    public function addCondition(string $sessionId, string $target, string $condition, int $duration): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)');\n        $stmt->execute([$sessionId, $target, $condition, $duration]);\n    }\n\n    public function advanceTurn(string $id): ?array\n    {\n        $session = $this->getSession($id);\n        if (!$session) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $count = count($session['order']);\n        if ($count === 0) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $newIndex = $session['turn_index'] + 1;\n        $newRound = $session['round'];\n        if ($newIndex >= $count) {\n            $newIndex = 0;\n            $newRound++;\n        }\n        $activeName = $session['order'][$newIndex]['name'];\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$id, $activeName]);\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $newRemaining = (int) $row['remaining_rounds'] - 1;\n            if ($newRemaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$newRemaining, $row['id']]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$row['id']]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?');\n        $upd->execute([$newRound, $newIndex, $id]);\n\n        $session['round'] = $newRound;\n        $session['turn_index'] = $newIndex;\n        $session['conditions'] = $this->getConditionsMap($id);\n        foreach ($session['order'] as $combatant) {\n            $name = $combatant['name'];\n            if (!isset($session['conditions'][$name])) {\n                $session['conditions'][$name] = [];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $session;\n    }\n\n    public function createMonster(array $data): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([\n                $data['slug'],\n                $data['name'],\n                $data['cr'],\n                $data['armor_class'],\n                $data['hit_points'],\n                json_encode($data['tags'] ?? ORDER BY id');\n        $stmt->execute([$row['id']]);\n        $milestones = [];\n        $doneCount = 0;\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $m) {\n            $isDone = (int) $m['done'] === 1;\n            $milestones[] = [\n                'milestone' => $m['milestone'],\n                'done' => $isDone,\n            ];\n            if ($isDone) {\n                $doneCount++;\n            }\n        }\n        $total = count($milestones);\n        $status = $row['status'];\n        if ($total > 0 && $doneCount === $total) {\n            $status = 'completed';\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'id' => $row['id'],\n            'campaign_id' => $row['campaign_id'],\n            'title' => $row['title'],\n            'status' => $status,\n            'milestones_total' => $total,\n            'milestones_done' => $doneCount,\n            'milestones' => $milestones,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public function updateQuestProgress(string $campaignId, string $questId, array $completed): ?array\n    {\n        $quest = $this->getQuest($questId);\n        if (!$quest || $quest['campaign_id'] !== $campaignId) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE quest_milestones SET done = 1 WHERE quest_id = ?   ];\n    }\n\n    public function healPlayCampaignCharacterByConsumption(string $campaignId, string $characterId, int $amount): void\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $hpAfter = min($member['hp_max'], $member['hp_current'] + $amount);\n        $this->updatePlayCampaignMemberHp($campaignId, $member['username'], $hpAfter);\n    }\n\n    public function recordDeathSave(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $successes = $member['death_save_successes'];\n        $failures = $member['death_save_failures'];\n        $status = $member['status'];\n\n        if ($outcome === 'success') {\n            $successes++;\n            if ($successes >= 3) {\n                $status = 'stable';\n            }\n        } elseif ($outcome === 'failure') {\n            $failures++;\n            if ($failures >= 3) {\n                $status = 'dead';\n            }\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$successes, $failures, $status, $campaignId, $characterId]);\n\n        return [\n            'character_id' => $characterId,\n            'successes' => $successes,\n            'failures' => $failures,\n            'status' => $status,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    private function getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $monsterId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, hp_max, hp_current, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId, $monsterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'monster_id' => $row['monster_id'],\n            'name' => $row['name'],\n            'hp_max' => (int) $row['hp_max'],\n            'hp_current' => (int) $row['hp_current'],\n            'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n        ];\n    }\n\n    private function updatePlayCampaignEncounterMonsterHp(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $monsterId, int $hpCurrent): bool\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? AND monster_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $campaignId, $encounterId, $monsterId]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    private function isPlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target): bool\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $combatants = json_decode($row['combatants_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($combatants as $c) {\n            if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $target) {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private function updatePlayCampaignMemberHp(string $campaignId, string $username, int $hpCurrent): bool\n    {\n        if ($hpCurrent > 0) {\n            $status = 'conscious';\n            $successes = 0;\n            $failures = 0;\n        } else {\n            $status = 'unconscious';\n            $successes = 0;\n            $failures = 0;\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([json_encode($entries, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert a new combatant into an existing stored order by initiative.\n     */\n    private function insertEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $newEntry): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $filtered = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            if (($entry['kind'] ?? '') === $kind && ($entry['id'] ?? '') === $id) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            $filtered[] = $entry;\n        }\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $filtered);\n    }\n\n    private function combatantIdentifier(?array $combatant): ?string\n    {\n        if ($combatant === null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (($combatant['kind'] ?? '') === 'monster') {\n            return $combatant['monster_id'] ?? null;\n        }\n\n        return $combatant['member'] ?? null;\n    }\n\n    private function pluralizeSlug(string $slug): string\n    {\n        $segments = explode('-', $slug);\n        $lastIndex = count($segments) - 1;\n        $last = $segments[$lastIndex];\n        if (!str_ends_with($last, 's')) {\n            $segments[$lastIndex] = $last . 's';\n        }\n\n        return implode('_', $segments);\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryItems(string $campaignId, string $characterId): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n            $select->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            $row = $select->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $current = (int) $row['quantity'];\n            if ($current < $quantity) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $remaining = $current - $quantity;\n            if ($remaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$remaining, $campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            }\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return $remaining;\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignCharacterEquipment(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string $slot): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, attuned FROM play_campaign_character_equipment WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND status = 'open'\");\n            $upd->execute([$winner, $campaignId, $lootId]);\n            if ($upd->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $ins = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)   ];\n    }\n\n    public function healPlayCampaignCharacterByConsumption(string $campaignId, string $characterId, int $amount): void\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $hpAfter = min($member['hp_max'], $member['hp_current'] + $amount);\n        $this->updatePlayCampaignMemberHp($campaignId, $member['username'], $hpAfter);\n    }\n\n    public function recordDeathSave(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $successes = $member['death_save_successes'];\n        $failures = $member['death_save_failures'];\n        $status = $member['status'];\n\n        if ($outcome === 'success') {\n            $successes++;\n            if ($successes >= 3) {\n                $status = 'stable';\n            }\n        } elseif ($outcome === 'failure') {\n            $failures++;\n            if ($failures >= 3) {\n                $status = 'dead';\n            }\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$successes, $failures, $status, $campaignId, $characterId]);\n\n        return [\n            'character_id' => $characterId,\n            'successes' => $successes,\n            'failures' => $failures,\n            'status' => $status,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    private function getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $monsterId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, hp_max, hp_current, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId, $monsterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'monster_id' => $row['monster_id'],\n            'name' => $row['name'],\n            'hp_max' => (int) $row['hp_max'],\n            'hp_current' => (int) $row['hp_current'],\n            'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n        ];\n    }\n\n    private function updatePlayCampaignEncounterMonsterHp(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $monsterId, int $hpCurrent): bool\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? AND monster_id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $campaignId, $encounterId, $monsterId]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    private function isPlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target): bool\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $combatants = json_decode($row['combatants_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($combatants as $c) {\n            if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $target) {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private function updatePlayCampaignMemberHp(string $campaignId, string $username, int $hpCurrent): bool\n    {\n        if ($hpCurrent > 0) {\n            $status = 'conscious';\n            $successes = 0;\n            $failures = 0;\n        } else {\n            $status = 'unconscious';\n            $successes = 0;\n            $failures = 0;\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([json_encode($entries, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert a new combatant into an existing stored order by initiative.\n     */\n    private function insertEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $newEntry): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $filtered = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            if (($entry['kind'] ?? '') === $kind && ($entry['id'] ?? '') === $id) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            $filtered[] = $entry;\n        }\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $filtered);\n    }\n\n    private function combatantIdentifier(?array $combatant): ?string\n    {\n        if ($combatant === null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (($combatant['kind'] ?? '') === 'monster') {\n            return $combatant['monster_id'] ?? null;\n        }\n\n        return $combatant['member'] ?? null;\n    }\n\n    private function pluralizeSlug(string $slug): string\n    {\n        $segments = explode('-', $slug);\n        $lastIndex = count($segments) - 1;\n        $last = $segments[$lastIndex];\n        if (!str_ends_with($last, 's')) {\n            $segments[$lastIndex] = $last . 's';\n        }\n\n        return implode('_', $segments);\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryItems(string $campaignId, string $characterId): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n            $select->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            $row = $select->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $current = (int) $row['quantity'];\n            if ($current < $quantity) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $remaining = $current - $quantity;\n            if ($remaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$remaining, $campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n            }\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return $remaining;\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignCharacterEquipment(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string $slot): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, attuned FROM play_campaign_character_equipment WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND status = 'open'\");\n            $upd->execute([$winner, $campaignId, $lootId]);\n            if ($upd->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $ins = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
